# FlowchartAI

FlowchartAI creates editable diagrams from text or one image, supports natural-language changes to native draw.io files, and saves owned documents for later editing. Hosted service: https://flowchartai.org.

## Product
- [AI flowchart editor](https://flowchartai.org/): Start a diagram from a description or an image.
- [Pricing](https://flowchartai.org/pricing): Current Credits subscriptions and one-time packs. Eligible historical Creem plans retain their allowance. Manual edits, save and download have no AI charge.
- [Blog](https://flowchartai.org/blog): Flowchart symbols, process diagrams and practical examples.

## Developers
- [Flowchart API](https://flowchartai.org/flowchart-api): Versioned REST API for native AI generation/editing, saved diagrams, task receipts, version history and native exports.
- [MCP server](https://flowchartai.org/mcp): Remote Streamable HTTP MCP with OAuth/PKCE or scoped API keys in clients supporting custom headers.
- [Quickstart and reference](https://flowchartai.org/developers/docs): Authentication, permissions, request examples, task recovery, usage and client setup.
- [OpenAPI JSON](https://flowchartai.org/api/v1/openapi.json): REST API v1 schema.
- [Developer dashboard](https://flowchartai.org/developers): Sign in to create, rotate and revoke keys, review OAuth connections and set daily budgets.

REST base: https://flowchartai.org/api/v1
MCP endpoint: https://flowchartai.org/api/mcp
Protected resource metadata: https://flowchartai.org/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/api/mcp
Authorization server metadata: https://flowchartai.org/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server

API writes require a stable Idempotency-Key. AI operations require max_credits and share the existing account wallet or eligible legacy request allowance. Model usage includes every call; settlement is capped at the accepted reservation. Do not repeat an uncertain submission with a new key before checking its receipt. API/MCP exports: draw.io XML and original JSON. Website native exports: draw.io, SVG and PNG. Keys and OAuth tokens do not provide website login sessions.
